ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Theft Hauler
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
BUILDING_THEFT_HAULER_1 — the heist verb: a pawn marked with RM_TheftHaulerExtension can uninstall ANY Building (not gated by the normal player-deconstruct/own-faction check) into a haulable MinifiedThing via a right-click float menu order, reusing vanilla's own uninstall-to-MinifiedThing machinery (JobDriver_RemoveBuilding, MinifyUtility.Uninstall). At the moment of uninstall it fires exactly one RimMandrake.Property.PropertyEngine.Fire TakingEvent(Act=Strip) unconditionally — PropertyEngine.Fire resolves the building's prior claim and authorization itself and is a no-op for an own-claim or unclaimed building, so a droid stripping its own colony's building stays silent, ordinary deconstruction.
Carries no new droid art/chassis and no settlement/district integration (design/Jawa/ wrecked_machines_resurrection.md's BUILDING_THEFT_HAULER_1 scope) — it is the generic "a marked pawn can steal a building" engine only, fully reusable off Star Wars content by any pawnkind an installed content mod chooses to mark. The included patch (MayRequire -gated) marks Droidworks' Muckraker Crab Droid chassis (the largest-bodied Droidworks race, RSW_DW_Race_OuterRim_MuckrakerDroid) as this pass's reused heavy hauler — no new race, per the item's own instruction to reuse an existing chassis.
